title: 65_HS1-101634279_100-DE-26505
doc_notes: This document is an FBI file regarding an interview with Wladyslaw Krasuski, who reported a 1944 UFO sighting in Germany, and also includes administrative correspondence regarding a 1966 inquiry from a UFO research group.

incidents.summary: Wladyslaw Krasuski observed a large, circular, vertically-rising vehicle near a German military compound while working as a prisoner of war.
incidents.quote: observed a circular enclosure approximately 100 to 150 yards in diameter
incidents.size: 75 to 100 yards in diameter, 14 feet high
